title: Degree bound for the zero slice
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb N$ and let $f:\mathbb F_2^{n+1}\to\mathbb F_2$. If the algebraic degree of $f$ in its algebraic normal form is at most $k$, then the algebraic degree of the function $x\mapsto f(0,x)$ is at most $k$.
hypotheses_covered: the algebraic degree of $f$ is at most $k$
